_approach: The canonical jazzy-house groove Attack Magazine's 'Jazzy House' dissection is built on: MPC-16 swing at 59% (engine 0.18), a humanized 4/4 kick, a clap on 2 and 4 preceded by a subtle ghost note, swung closed 16th hats and a muted cowbell accent. Reference: Attack Magazine 'Jazzy House', Kerri Chandler. (re-voiced for the Vermona DRM1 MKIII's 8 channels)
